## What and why

<!--
What problem does this solve, and what happens differently afterward?
For a behavior change, give a concrete before/after example when useful.
Link a relevant public issue if it supplies context; the description should still stand alone.
For a refactor, identify the complexity removed and the behavior preserved.
-->

## Validation

<!--
Give the checks actually run and their outcomes, including relevant failures or gaps.
Name the behavior covered by tests; "tests added", "CI green", or "AI reviewed" alone
does not explain what was validated. For prose/config-only work, relevant inspection is enough.
For visible or rendered-doc changes, include representative before/after images when useful.
Label sample data and the revisions shown; screenshots do not prove runtime behavior.
-->

<!--
When relevant, add a short Compatibility or Review notes section:
- Public signature/default/return/exception changes, deprecations, and migration impact.
- Dependencies on other PRs, deliberate convention exceptions, or unresolved decisions.
- For shared-policy changes: rationale, scope, exceptions, and adoption cost.
Do not leave empty sections, generic assurances, or checkboxes asserting everything is fine.
-->
